summary: Scott Benge of Telluride caught in a ~700-ft avalanche near Ophir while backcountry skiing with partner Kane Scheidegger on New Year's Eve; buried under at least 5 feet, unconscious with his airway full of snow; dug out alive after a ~5-minute beacon search plus help from fellow skier Sheamus Croke and ~a dozen others; a SAR team was alerted but called off before deploying; Benge skied out with the group
responding_agency: companions (San Miguel County SAR alerted, stood down)
notes: Durango Telegraph/CPR first-person account parent-opened and verified this run (Dec 31, 2022 = Saturday; full-burial companion rescue, SAR alerted but stood down). Scope per companion-rescue avalanche precedent (ids 2772/2770/2701/2698).
